title: FriendlyFire (LifeHeartsPro Addon)
description: A Friendly fire plugin for teams – Addon for LifeHeartsPro.
body:
# **FriendlyFire LHP Addon**
An addon for LifeHeartsPro

Take your server to the next level with **FriendlyFire LHP Addon** – the perfect extension for your LifeHeartsPro setup ❤️⚔️

This addon introduces **controlled friendly fire mechanics per team**, giving server owners full control over PvP between teammates while keeping everything balanced and configurable.

Whether you want intense PvP fights or structured team gameplay, this addon gives you the tools to manage it cleanly and efficiently.

---

## ✨ **Features:**
• ⚔️ Enable / disable friendly fire per team
• ❤️ Full integration with LifeHeartsPro heart system
• 🧠 Configurable PvP feedback (actionbar & sounds)
• 🛡️ Smart protection system (projectiles, potions, tridents, etc.)
• ⚙️ Lightweight & optimized performance
• 💬 Clean in-game info & management commands

---

## 🎮 Perfect for:
Survival servers • PvP events • Hardcore modes • Team-based gameplay

---

⚠️ **Note:** This is an addon and requires **LifeHeartsPro** to function.
